dedupe_keys.name: opencellid country and mobile country code retrieval pipeline

description: This Python tool retrieves OpenCellID inventory files by mobile country code or country name. The maintainer publishes a library and command-line interface that resolve country aliases, handle multiple MCCs, stream compressed CSV files and optionally extract them. Output coverage and observation dates come from the selected OpenCellID source files; the package does not create independent base-station measurements or guarantee complete national coverage. Code is available free under MIT from GitHub. Running the retrieval requires the user’s OpenCellID API key and compliance with the source service’s separate conditions. A limitation is that country/MCC coverage remains under development and a PyPI release is described as forthcoming, so installation currently uses the repository. The reported test suite uses mocked downloads and does not establish present server access for a particular account. Simulation uses include assembling location inputs for telecom exposure and capacity studies. It relates to data-opencellid as the upstream source. The package was not installed or run, no credentials were requested or handled, and no inventory files were downloaded.
name: OpenCellID country and mobile-country-code retrieval pipeline
notes: G8; G8-0232. Source code itself is public with no access restriction; obtaining upstream OpenCellID data later requires an API key. Metadata verification did not require sign-in.  Cited as: Repository documentation. No describing paper identified in the inspected metadata..
